sentences.text: On 17 May 2023 also, the deceased had narrated the ill-treatment meted out to her and informed the first informant that her husband Santosh, mother in law Vimla, brother in law Sushil, sister in law Moni and co-sister Neha were subjecting to her to cruelty over the household matters.
The first informant alleged, unable to bear the ill-treatment the deceased by suicide.
4. I have perused the allegations in the FIR carefully.
It seems the martial life of the deceased was afflicted with discord.
It does not, however, appear that there was any unlawful demand of money or property.
On the contrary, the deceased was allegedly harassed over household matters.
In the FIR, the allegations of the harassment even on the said count are not attributed to the applicant.
There is a passing reference in the FIR that the applicant was also subjecting the deceased to ill- treatment.
On 17 May 2023 also, the applicant was not named by the deceased as the person who harassed her.

5. In the circumstances of the case, the question as to whether there was any direct or proximate act or omission on the part of the applicant which can be considered as an instigation or intentional aid to commit suicide appears to be debatable.
In any event, the custodial interrogation of the applicant does not seem to be warranted to facilitate further investigation.
I am, therefore, inclined to exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant.

6. Hence, the following order :
SSP 2/3  
 ORDER (i) In the event of the arrest of the Applicant - Soni Ghanshymlal Jaiswal in connection with C.R.No.439 of 2023 registered with Narpoli Police Station, the Applicant be released on bail on Soni Ghanshymlal Jaiswal vs The State Of Maharashtra on 17 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35074749/
2 furnishing a PR bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
